Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.sg.internal.wrapper

Interface PickPointWrapper

All Superinterfaces:
PickShapeWrapper
public interface PickPointWrapper extends PickShapeWrapper
PickPoint is a pick shape defined as a single point. It can be used as an argument to the picking methods in BranchGroup and Locale.
